hooks.name: Format & lint on save
hooks.description: Format app source and check design-system and kid-safety steering rules.

action.prompt: A source file was just saved. Format it consistently with 2-space indentation, double quotes in JS and HTML attributes, semicolons in JS, no trailing whitespace, and a final newline. Then report undeclared variables, unused functions, console.log calls, external calls or URLs, personal-information inputs, shame copy, hard-coded component colors outside the :root palette, and interactive elements smaller than 56 by 56 pixels. Fix formatting directly, list lint findings briefly, and do not change behavior without asking. Follow .kiro/steering/kid-safety.md and .kiro/steering/design-system.md.
